title: pellionia undulata
intro: Pellionia undulata, commonly known as the "Wandering Liverwort", is a type of plant species in the family Urticaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellionia undulata are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which may aid in wound healing and immune system regulation. The bioactive constituents of Pellionia undulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
